name: 脆嫩爆汁果切杨桃款
description: 暖琥珀长图：整果主图、爆汁断面微距、吃法四宫格到防磕碰包装

styleLock.direction: warm amber fresh star-fruit detail-page commerce with cream fields, amber bands, rounded-corner photo insets and amber icon discs
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for packshots, warm apricot-cream #F7F1E6 info fields carrying broad amber-orange #D08A28 bands with soft wavy white edges, and a matte pale concrete-grey #C9C6C0 styling board inside the photo insets
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio light from the front-left with gentle fill, 5500K, soft contact shadows, glistening juicy cut surfaces, no harsh speculars and never plastic
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte pale concrete-grey board #C9C6C0 for fruit close-ups, matte warm board #EFE9E1 for macro, warm wood #A9743F board for the scene shot
styleLock.typography: modern bold geometric sans-serif headlines, charcoal-brown #3B3025 on cream fields and pure white #FFFFFF on amber panels, labels 10-14pt
styleLock.iconSystem: solid amber disc badges #D08A28 with thin white line icons, thin amber outline circle badges and pill-shaped amber label chips with white text
styleLock.presentationRules: stable product scale; the five-ridge star cross-section always faces the camera; photo insets keep the same rounded corner radius and a thin white stroke
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm star-fruit detail-page visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, warm apricot-cream #F7F1E6 fields, amber-orange accent #D08A28 and charcoal-brown text #3B3025; warm tone throughout; seamless white #FFFFFF packshot fields and warm apricot-cream #F7F1E6 info fields with broad amber-orange #D08A28 bands carrying soft wavy white edges; bright soft studio light from the front-left with gentle fill, 5500K, soft contact shadows, glistening juicy cut surfaces, no harsh speculars and never plastic; matte pale concrete-grey #C9C6C0 styling boards for fruit close-ups and a warm wood #A9743F board for the scene shot; modern bold geometric sans-serif headlines in #3B3025 on cream and #FFFFFF on amber; consistent rounded-corner photo insets with a thin white stroke, consistent amber disc badges #D08A28 with thin white line icons, thin amber outline circle badges and pill-shaped amber label chips; stable product scale with the five-ridge star cross-section always facing the camera; every frame composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索位一眼点击，整果与切角同框说清五棱星形与鲜黄果色，干净合规
shots.camera: 正面平视、轻微 3/4 转向；整果立起一根棱脊朝向镜头，旁边一只干净切角，全果完整不出画
shots.lighting: 明亮均匀高调棚拍光，前左侧主光配补光，两只果体下软接触阴影，切面湿润反光
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. One whole fruit standing upright with a single ridge facing the camera and one clean wedge cut beside it showing the five-ridge star cross-section with translucent juicy flesh, photographed straight-on at eye level with a slight 3/4 turn, full product visible and never clipped, the fruit group filling 60-70% of the frame with the two pieces balanced on a clean diagonal. Bright even high-key studio lighting from the front-left with gentle fill, a soft contact shadow grounding both pieces. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. 4K, commercial fresh-fruit e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no watermark, no brand logo, no extra text, no cut-off edges, no plastic-looking skin, no artificial dew droplets, no duplicated fruit.

shots.displayName: 琥珀底爆汁断面卖点图
shots.intent: 主图一秒法则：厚切断面在暖琥珀色带上爆汁感立现，一句短标题压住画面
shots.camera: 45° 高角度俯拍；厚切断面朝镜头置于前景，整果在后方柔焦陪衬
shots.lighting: 正面柔和棚拍光加补光，软接触阴影，断面湿润高光
shots.background: 杏米色场 #F7F1E6，下部三分之一压一条宽琥珀橙 #D08A28 色带，带柔和白色波浪边
shots.props: 一枚细线图标（水滴或叶片），不遮挡果体
shots.textZone: 上部三分之一为标题区：一句短标题 「{selling_point_1}」 于 #3B3025，旁侧一枚细线图标
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A thick wedge cut from the fruit with its five-ridge star cross-section and translucent juicy flesh turned to the camera, photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down, the whole fruit resting softly out of focus behind it, the fruit filling 50-60% of the frame and anchoring the lower two thirds. Bright soft studio light from the front with a soft contact shadow and a wet highlight on the cut face. Warm apricot-cream field #F7F1E6 carrying a broad amber-orange #D08A28 band across the lower third with a soft wavy white edge. The upper third reads as the headline zone with one short headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #3B3025 beside one thin-line icon, so the whole frame completes as one balanced layout. Negative: no dense body text, no more than one claim, no invented nutrition, health or efficacy claims, no brand logo, no watermark, no props covering the fruit, no plastic-looking surface.

shots.intent: 微距证明皮薄肉厚、断面晶莹，把爆汁感落到可验证的质地上
shots.camera: 极限微距特写，浅景深前实后虚；切面薄皮与半透明果肉的交界填满画面
shots.lighting: 右侧贴近侧逆光刮擦质感，一处柔和湿润高光，无硬反光
shots.whitespace: minimal, detail is the whole point
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on the cut face where the thin waxy peel meets the translucent juicy flesh, the crisp five-ridge star edge and the fine flesh grain filling the frame. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shallow depth of field with the foreground sharp. Raking side light from the right revealing the fine flesh texture and one soft wet highlight. Neutral matte board background #EFE9E1. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame with only minimal margins around it, because the detail is the whole point. Negative: no blurry subject, no extra text, no watermark, no brand logo, no props, no over-smoothed plastic texture, no artificial dew droplets, no fake seeds, no duplicated texture patches.

shots.intent: 放大买到干柴、青涩、寡淡果的普遍痛点，反衬本款断面多汁
shots.camera: 双格分屏，两格机位、景别与裁切完全一致，均为平视纪实感构图
shots.lighting: 两格光位一致；左格平光发闷，右格同光位下清透，断面湿润反光
shots.background: 哑光浅灰台面 #C9C6C0，两格同底色
shots.props: 左格一只普通果切片作示意；右格本款厚切断面
shots.textZone: 每格上方一枚短标签 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」 于 #3B3025
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen, two matched panels with identical framing, identical crop and identical camera position, both photographed at eye level with a candid documentary feel. Left panel: one generic dull pale fruit slice that reads dry, mealy and pithy under flat tired light on a matte pale grey counter #C9C6C0, communicating a dry, sour, under-ripe bite. Right panel: {product} on the same counter #C9C6C0 under the same light position, freshly cut with glistening juicy flesh and the five-ridge star cross-section facing the camera. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Each panel fills 40-50% of its half with the subject and carries one short label 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #3B3025 above it, the two panels separated by a clean even gutter so the split screen reads as one balanced layout. Negative: no fabricated statistics, ratings or test data, no competitor brand marks, no brand logo, no watermark, no extra text, no deformed fruit, no plastic-looking surface, no mismatched framing between panels.

shots.intent: 把果切放进真实下午茶场景，让买家代入自己端盘分食的瞬间
shots.camera: 平视轻微 3/4，手持纪实感到窗边；切片扇形铺盘，整果立于后景
shots.lighting: 左侧柔和自然窗光，5500K，软接触阴影，切面湿润反光，背景柔和虚化
shots.background: 暖木台面 #A9743F 上浅色陶瓷盘，背景亚麻与虚化的透明饮杯
shots.props: 浅色陶瓷盘、亚麻餐巾、一杯冰饮（虚化），不遮挡果体
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: {product} slices fanned out on a pale ceramic plate on a warm wood #A9743F table beside a linen napkin, one whole fruit resting behind, a glass of iced tea softly out of focus in the background. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed at eye level at a gentle 3/4 angle with a candid handheld feel, the plated fruit filling 40-50% of the frame in the lower half. Soft natural window light from the left, 5500K, soft contact shadows, glistening juicy cut surfaces. Negative: no hands, no visible face, no brand logo, no watermark, no extra text, no cutlery clutter, no floating fruit without a contact shadow, no plastic look.

shots.displayName: 果径规格与挑选信息图
shots.intent: 用俯拍信息图回答果径、单果形态与挑选标准，消除规格疑虑
shots.camera: 正上方 90° 俯拍，整果平躺于规格卡内，配细尺寸线与短标签
shots.lighting: 均匀扁平高调棚拍光，无戏剧性阴影
shots.background: 杏米色场 #F7F1E6 上一张干净白色 #FFFFFF 圆角信息卡
shots.props: 细琥珀橙 #D08A28 尺寸线与两三枚白描边圆角标签牌
shots.textZone: 卡内尺寸线标注与短标签 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」 于 #3B3025
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic size and pick screen for {product}, the whole fruit shown from directly above at a 90-degree overhead angle lying on a clean white #FFFFFF rounded info card inside a warm apricot-cream #F7F1E6 field, the card filling 65-75% of the frame with about 15% panel margins on all sides. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even flat high-key studio light, no dramatic shadow. Thin amber-orange #D08A28 dimension lines run along the fruit ridge with two or three rounded white-stroked label plates, and the callouts read 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #3B3025; no numbers are rendered, the values are supplied at generation time. Negative: no tiny unreadable text, no dense body text, no invented weight, grade or origin claims, no fake certification marks, no brand logo, no watermark, no cut-off card edges.

shots.intent: 用四宫格给出洗净、切块、切片等吃法选择，降低“不会吃”的犹豫
shots.camera: 四格同一轻微 3/4 机位与同一裁切；每格分别为整果、对切、厚片、薄星片
shots.lighting: 四格光位与色温完全一致，均匀柔和，软接触阴影
shots.background: 四格同为哑光浅灰台面 #C9C6C0，外套白色 #FFFFFF 圆角卡与细琥珀橙 #D08A28 描边
shots.textZone: 每格下方一条短标注 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」 于 #3B3025
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant grid screen of {product} showing four matched squares in one clean 2x2 grid, each square presenting the same fruit a different way. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The four squares show a whole fruit, a halved wedge with the five-ridge star cross-section facing the camera, thick slices and thin star slices, all shot from the same slight 3/4 hero angle with identical lighting and identical crop in every square. Each square sits on the same matte pale grey board #C9C6C0 inside a white #FFFFFF rounded card with a thin amber-orange #D08A28 outline, with one short caption 「{callout_1}」, 「{callout_2}」, 「{callout_3}」 and 「{callout_4}」 in #3B3025 below each square. The fruit fills 60-70% of the frame overall and the grid reads as one complete balanced layout with even gutters. Negative: no mixed lighting between squares, no color shift between squares, no brand logo, no watermark, no extra text, no duplicated fruit inside one square, no plastic look.

shots.intent: 用开箱俯拍展示托盘与网套的防磕碰结构，先解决运输破损这一最后顾虑
shots.camera: 45° 高角度俯拍开箱；箱内托盘与网套清晰，一只果微微提起展示缓冲层
shots.lighting: 正面顶部均匀高调棚拍光，软接触阴影，无戏剧性阴影
shots.background: 白色 #FFFFFF 台面上一只素面无字纸箱，箱内浅牛皮色 #C9A46B 纸托
shots.props: 模压纸托、泡沫网套、盖沿一小段胶带的撕裂痕，均为可验证的包装细节
shots.textZone: 两枚短信任标签 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」 于 #3B3025
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust screen of the {product} packing, photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down into an open plain box with a molded pulp tray and soft foam net sleeves cradling the fruit, one piece lifted slightly aside to show the padding, the packed fruit filling 60-70% of the frame. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even high-key studio light from the front-top, soft contact shadows, no dramatic shadow. Clean white #FFFFFF surface with a light kraft #C9A46B box interior, the molded pulp tray and foam net texture rendered sharp and tangible as the trust evidence. Two short trust labels 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #3B3025 sit beside the box. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, awards, ratings or test data; no fabricated badges, no shipping guarantees, no brand logo, no store mark, no QR code, no watermark, no extra text.

shots.intent: 低角度仰拍收口，琥珀面板压住当季鲜果主题，实色行动按钮把决策收束到下单
shots.camera: 极低机位仰视 3/4，整果居前、两块厚切断面在后，五棱星形朝镜头
shots.lighting: 均匀柔和棚拍光，软接触阴影，比全组略提亮更利落
shots.background: 杏米色场 #F7F1E6 上一块圆角琥珀橙 #D08A28 面板
shots.props: 一枚圆角琥珀橙 #D08A28 行动按钮，白字短标语
shots.textZone: 琥珀面板内标题 「{callout_1}」 于 #FFFFFF，短副标 「{callout_2}」，圆角行动按钮内白字 「{callout_3}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce closing CTA shot of {product}, a group of one whole fruit with two thick wedges behind it, the five-ridge star cross-section facing the camera, photographed from a very low angle looking upward at a slight 3/4 turn, the fruit group filling 65-75% of the frame. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Bright soft studio light with soft contact shadows, slightly punchier than the rest of the set. Warm apricot-cream field #F7F1E6 with one rounded amber-orange #D08A28 panel holding the headline 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF, one short sub-label 「{callout_2}」 and a solid rounded CTA button with short white CTA text 「{callout_3}」, completing the frame as one balanced composition. Negative: no real discount numbers, no invented shipping, service or certification claims, no fake countdown, no brand logo, no QR code, no watermark, no extra text.

provenance.notes: 从 9 屏杨桃爆款详情长图切片提炼；已剥离原产地/资质类声明（产地名、高山种植、农家肥不打药、果园直发、自然栽培等）、营养与功效类词汇（维生素/维C/美容/助消化等）、原店二维码与会员入口、原标题文案与超大英文水印字、以及原独特排版；图内中文一律改为 「」+ 占位符，原文中的具体数值类表述统一转为 {callout} 文案槽由使用方填写；保留的只是暖琥珀色带 + 白描边圆角图框 + 琥珀圆盘图标 + 果切断面的视觉语法，产品一律以 {product} 占位。按 taxonomy 判定为生鲜粮油/水果，与库内羊角蜜瓜、网纹蜜瓜等水果套图区分。
